tagline: 索尼数码单反相机，2008 年发布
description: 索尼于2008年推出的数码单反相机。配备interchangeable, Sony α / Konica Minolta A mount。快门速度electronically controlled, vertical-traverse, focal-plane Shutter。

specs.传感器: 23.6 mm × 15.8 mm, 10.2 effective megapixels CCD, 1.5 × FOV crop
specs.镜头: interchangeable, Sony α / Konica Minolta A mount
specs.曝光测光: 40-segment honeycomb sensing system provides multi-pattern measuring
specs.取景器: 0.83x magnification, 95% frame coverage, Pentamirror, Spherical Acute Matte screen, 17.6mm eye relief, diopter adjustment
specs.闪光灯: Manual Pop-up: Auto, Fill-flash, Rear flash sync, Wireless off camera flash (with Flash HVL-F56AM, F36AM), GN12 at ISO 100 (39 feet/ 12 meters)
specs.存储: CompactFlash I/II, Memory Stick PRO (with adapter), Memory Stick PRO Duo (with adapter)
